findings.result: WEAKENED — inversion found by the lane's own audit
findings.detail: The ladder is monotonic in ongoing access granted, not in sensitivity of data exposed. A rung-1 HAR export (no standing access) carries live cookies, bearer tokens and customer records; rung-4 attention telemetry (installed agent) carries only window titles. Conflating the axes would under-protect the cheap-looking rungs.
findings.correction: Escalation now governed by two independent scores (access_persistence, content_sensitivity). Corrected in first-principles.md, research-report.md and decision-ledger.json (D-P01-02).

findings.result: QUALIFIED — survives only with the 'LLM-driven' qualifier
findings.detail: Cross-segment audit found maintained, genuinely permissive questionnaire engines with real conditional logic outside the dialog segment: SurveyKing (MIT), xiaoju-survey (Apache-2.0), Formily, FormKit, uniforms, formio.js. findings.correction: Build-not-adopt now scoped to the adaptive half only; deterministic question-graph half has adoptable prior art. Corrected in research-report.md, decision-ledger.json (D-P01-03) and lane-synthesis.md.
